jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Sterling Cooper Digital builds campaign-planning software for agencies across North America. Our product team works in English.

What you'll do

  • Build Java services with Spring Boot
  • Design REST APIs and SQL schemas
  • Ship features with a small, friendly team

What we're looking for

  • Java and object-oriented programming
  • Spring Boot
  • SQL
  • Git
  • Genuine interest in financial technology
  • A passion for clean code
  • Bilingualism (French and English) is required

Hybrid from Montreal or Toronto. We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.

jobs.title: AI Engineer, New Grad
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join our applied-AI team building assistants that draft campaign briefs.

Responsibilities

  • Build LLM features with retrieval-augmented generation
  • Evaluate model outputs against labeled data
  • Deploy services on AWS

Requirements

  • Python
  • Experience with LLM APIs
  • Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
  • LangChain
  • AWS Certified Developer - Associate certification (required)

Hybrid in Montreal, 2 days a week. We are an equal opportunity employer. This company is fictional and exists only in the Prospect demo.
